criticalFailureMechanism: FirstEnergy 345kV lines sagged into overgrown trees in Ohio; software alarm race condition prevented operator awareness; cascading line tripping across 8 US states and Ontario.
dcOperationalLesson: Established the Uptime Institute standard for minimum 48 hours of on-site diesel generator fuel storage without reliance on external supply chains.

criticalFailureMechanism: Uninsulated instrument sensing lines froze, tripping 152 generating units simultaneously; ERCOT initiated rolling blackouts during Super Bowl XLV week.
dcOperationalLesson: Demonstrated that ERCOT thermal power plants lacked winterization standards, foreshadowing the 2021 Uri catastrophe.

criticalFailureMechanism: Widespread western heatwave coincided with cloud cover reducing solar output and low wind during evening net load ramp (the 'Duck Curve' neck).
dcOperationalLesson: Prompted Silicon Valley hyperscalers to invest heavily in 4-hour lithium iron phosphate (LFP) BESS installations to survive evening CAISO Flex Alerts.

eventName: Winter Storm Uri ERCOT Grid Catastrophe
criticalFailureMechanism: Wellhead freeze-offs cut gas supply to power plants by 45%; wind turbine blades iced; grid frequency dropped to 59.3 Hz, within 4 minutes and 37 seconds of total statewide blackout.
dcOperationalLesson: Data centers exposed to real-time index power pricing suffered tens of millions in electricity bills; sparked mandatory dual-fuel generators and bilateral fixed PPAs.

criticalFailureMechanism: All-time record temperatures (Portland 116°F, Seattle 108°F); transmission line thermal ratings derated; air density loss cut cooling tower effectiveness.
dcOperationalLesson: Forced redesign of ASHRAE thermal envelope specifications for Pacific Northwest data centers historically designed solely for free evaporative economizers.

eventName: Winter Storm Elliott PJM & TVA Emergency
criticalFailureMechanism: Flash freeze dropped temperatures 30°F in 3 hours; gas pipeline pressure dropped across Appalachia; PJM declared Maximum Generation Emergency and assessed $1.8B in Non-Performance Penalties.
dcOperationalLesson: Ashburn data center operators were called to shed grid load and run emergency backup generators for over 36 continuous hours to avert widespread PJM outages.

criticalFailureMechanism: Category 1 hurricane brought 85 mph winds that downed thousands of CenterPoint distribution circuits; restoration took over 8 days during 95°F+ heatwave.
dcOperationalLesson: Highlighted transmission-level interconnection vs distribution vulnerability: facilities with dedicated 138kV/345kV substation drop lines remained online while distribution-connected sites failed.
